title: EOS project declaration
description: What this project IS and how it is verified. Authoritative for the product-quality gate (project-gate.mjs), the G-EVAL paradigm signal (eos-doctor.mjs) and the workflow profile (.github/eos/eos.mjs).

audit.description: Dependency / supply-chain audit (npm audit, pip-audit, cargo audit, govulncheck …). Not part of the per-push quality gate: it is executed by the release gate, where a network failure is DEFERRED and never a PASS.

workflowProfile.description: Key into .eos/workflow.json profiles. Defaults to standard-product.

complianceProfile.description: Advisory declaration only, and it can only TIGHTEN: docs/compliance-profile.json stays the authoritative record of the data-boundary decision (audit EOS-004). Declaring "regulated" here turns the compliance checks on even before that file exists; declaring "none" never turns them off.

evidencePolicy.description: How much provenance this project's release evidence must carry. A regulated project MUST state it — leaving it unset fails, because 'nobody decided' is not a policy. It may legitimately choose "local": an air-gapped environment cannot reach an attestation authority at all, and refusing to ship there would exclude exactly the users who need governance most. State the reason in evidencePolicyReason.

evidencePolicyReason.description: Why this policy is the right one for this project — required when a regulated project chooses "local".

command.description: A command string, an argv array, or an array of command strings to chain. Null means explicitly not applicable.
